description:
Field AI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that enable robots to operate in complex, unpredictable environments. By combining advanced AI, robotics, and real-world deployment experience, we are developing solutions that move beyond simulation and deliver measurable impact across industries.
Our systems are already deployed globally, helping customers unlock new possibilities in construction, security, mining, manufacturing, and beyond. We are building the foundation for the next generation of embodied intelligence—where robots can understand, navigate, and operate safely in the world around them.
About the Job
Field AI is building the future of autonomy—from rugged field environments to real-world customer deployments. We’re looking for a Mapping Solution Engineer who can bring our 3D mapping solutions to life by owning deployment, integration, and ongoing performance in the field.
This role sits at the intersection of robotics engineering, customer delivery, and technical problem-solving. You’ll work hands-on with 3D mapping systems, robots, sensors, and customer environments to ensure successful deployments while continuously improving reliability through field feedback.
You’ll collaborate closely with software engineers, robotics teams, operations, and customers to deliver mapping solutions that operate in large-scale, unstructured environments. If you enjoy building technology that leaves the lab, solving complex real-world problems, and seeing your work directly enable autonomous systems, this is your role.
What You’ll Get To Do
1. Develop and Deploy 3D Mapping Solutions
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade software for 3D mapping applications.
Deploy large-scale mapping systems and data processing pipelines into real-world environments.
Validate mapping systems and algorithms through testing on robots, sensors, and field deployments.
Build internal tooling, automation, and benchmarking infrastructure to improve reliability, performance, and repeatability.
Troubleshoot and optimize mapping workflows across software, hardware, and data pipelines.
2. Own Solution Delivery and Field Deployment
Lead end-to-end delivery of mapping data products, including data capture, processing, quality validation, and customer handoff.
Support on-site and remote deployments, ensuring systems are operational and performing as expected.
Conduct technical demonstrations, pilots, and evaluations for prospective and existing customers.
Partner with internal engineering teams and customers to identify issues, gather feedback, and drive improvements.
Develop scalable deployment processes, documentation, and best practices to improve future rollouts.
3. Bridge Field Operations and Engineering
Translate real-world deployment challenges into actionable technical improvements.
Analyze field data and system performance to improve mapping reliability and customer outcomes.
Work across robotics, software, operations, and customer teams to solve complex technical challenges.
Support mission-critical robotic deployments in dynamic and unpredictable environments.
What You Have
Master’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Geomatics, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
2+ years of experience in robotics software development, 3D mapping, systems integration, or field deployment of complex technical systems.
Strong programming skills in C++ and Python with experience writing production-quality software.
Experience with 3D geometry, point cloud processing, and algorithms such as ICP and NDT.
Familiarity with point cloud libraries and tools such as PCL or Open3D.
Experience working with LiDAR systems and 3D data formats including PCD, PLY, E57, or LAS.
Familiarity with ROS, Git, and Linux/Ubuntu-based development environments.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, hardware, and networking systems.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Willingness to travel and work on-site with customers as needed.
The Extras That Set You Apart
Experience with geospatial data, georeferencing, coordinate systems, survey control, or calibration workflows.
Experience deploying and maintaining mission-critical robotics or autonomous systems in real-world environments.
Familiarity with point cloud and survey software such as CloudCompare, Leica Cyclone, Faro Scene, or Trimble RealWorks.
Experience working directly with customers in high-stakes technical environments.
Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Wrike, or Confluence.
Background in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, or field robotics.
Experience working at a startup or high-growth company with a strong ownership mindset.
Why Join Field AI?
We are solving one of the world’s most complex challenges: deploying intelligent robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. Our Field Foundational Models™ enable robots to perceive, reason, and operate safely in the real world, creating a new generation of autonomous systems.
You’ll work alongside a world-class team of researchers, engineers, and builders from organizations including DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX.
At Field AI, you’ll have the opportunity to work on technology that moves beyond the lab—building systems that operate in the real world and redefine what robots can do.
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We’re looking for people who challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and thrive in environments where the answers aren’t already known. Join a team of engineers, researchers, field operators, and innovators working together to bring embodied intelligence into the world.

Compensation and Benefits
We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary; base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  Also, while we enjoy being together on-site, we are open to exploring a hybrid or remote option.
 
Why Join Field AI?
We are solving one of the world’s most complex challenges: deploying robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. Our Field Foundational Models™ set a new standard in perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, ensuring our approach is explainable and safe for deployment.
 
You will have the opportunity to work with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. With a decade-long track record of deploying solutions in the field, winning DARPA challenge segments, and bringing expertise from organizations like DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise Self-Driving, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, we are set to achieve our ambitious goals.
 
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
To tackle such ambitious challenges, we need a team as unique as our vision — innovators who go beyond conventional methods and are eager to tackle tough, uncharted questions. We’re seeking individuals who challenge the status quo, dive into uncharted territory, and bring interdisciplinary expertise. Our team requires not only top AI talent but also exceptional software developers, engineers, product designers, field deployment experts, and communicators.
 
We are headquartered in always-sunny Irvine, Southern California and have US based and global teammates. 
 
Join us, shape the future, and be part of a fun, close-knit team on an exciting journey!
